paper_metadata.title: Effect of heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Mg-Gd-Y-Zr alloys fabricated by wire arc additive manufacturing

evidence.quote: In this work, Mg-9.54Gd-1.82Y-0.44Zr (wt.%, GW92) alloy thin-walled components were fabricated by cold metal transfer (CMT) arc in CMT-Advance mode.
